integrity.finite_computation_limit: 951 deterministic numerical checks supplement but cannot replace the universal analytic proof.
integrity.independence: No independent mathematical audit or certification is claimed.
integrity.prior_work: The general integer-oversampling Zak/Janssen representation and the Poisson frame-property criterion are prior work.

scientific_limitations: Only integer redundancy q >= 2 and the lattice with unit translations and modulation spacing 1/q are covered.
The formula uses unnormalized g_w(t)=1/(t^2+w^2) and w>0.
The unique global width optimizer is proved only for q=2, not for every q.
The full text of Janssen (1996) could not be inspected, so implicit prior coverage remains possible.
title: Exact integer-oversampling Poisson Gabor bounds and optimal redundancy-two width
